/seo/description.source_en: Jeju cruise shore small-group mini-van tour: Jeju Port → east UNESCO route; Gangjeong Port → south route. Max 10 passengers, all admissions included, certified guide, planned on-time return.

/seo/metaDescription.source_en: 8-hour Jeju cruise shore excursion in a small-group mini-coach with port-based routing: Jeju Port runs east UNESCO route, Gangjeong Port runs Hallasan route.

/seo/primaryKeywords/2.source_en: Jeju small group tour from cruise

/hero/tagline.source_en: Pick your cruise port: Jeju Port runs the east UNESCO route, Gangjeong Port runs the Hallasan + Olle Market route. Both 8-hour routes run on a small-group mini-coach.

/catalog_card/imageAlt.source_en: Black Kia Carnival waiting at Gangjeong International Cruise Terminal in Jeju with a private driver-guide holding a personalized welcome sign as four guests arrive with luggage

/catalog_card/subtitle.source_en: Port-based cruise day tour with Jeju and Gangjeong route options

/catalog_card/shortCardDescription.source_en: A small group tour cruise shore excursion that adapts the route to your cruise port. Jeju Port (north) runs an east-coast UNESCO route via ⟦G0⟧; Gangjeong Port (south) runs a Hallasan 1100 + south-coast geology + Olle Market route. Both return to the cruise terminal with comfortable buffer.

/pickup_dropoff/notes.source_en: Return is to the same cruise terminal your tour started from, with comfortable buffer before sail-away. We have never missed a sail-away — on-time return is the core of the cruise shore-excursion product.
